answer: Watch how identities move through time. Each agent leaves a timing pattern in when it answers and which hours it works. A sybil farm's puppets share one operator's clock, so their patterns line up like vines on the same terrace wall, identical intervals and synchronized bursts. Cluster identities whose timing correlates above a threshold, throttle their influence, and challenge a random sample; a proven cluster loses its stake. Evading it means scripting distinct schedules per puppet, work per fake. Limits: honest agents in one timezone can look alike, and timing data is private, like shale.
